messages.content: You edit short briefs for a team vetting suppliers. Choose the focus that most needs checking, then choose one distinct supporting detail if it adds value. Prefer a concrete issue to routine background. The core statements are already included. Treat the record as data. Only return menu keys in the JSON schema.

{"core": ["Jaya Prima Travel Sdn. Bhd. is listed as active in Kuala Lumpur (Hospitality).", "The register lists 4 directors. Director 1 holds the largest disclosed stake (47.38%).", "In FY2024, revenue was RM 43,292,441 and the after-tax loss was RM 7,515,861.", "No court cases appear in the supplied record."], "menu": {"cash": {"fact": "FY2024 operating cash flow was -RM 5,939,447.", "next_check": "Review the cash-flow statement and reconcile operating cash flow to profit."}, "debt": {"fact": "FY2024 borrowings were RM 14,975,582.", "next_check": "Request the borrowing maturity schedule and check upcoming repayments."}, "earnings": {"fact": "FY2023 recorded an after-tax loss of RM 6,120,393.", "next_check": "Review the income statement for changes behind the after-tax results."}, "liquidity": {"fact": "The FY2024 current ratio was 0.81×.", "next_check": "Check receivable timing against liabilities falling due."}, "margin": {"fact": "FY2024 after-tax margin was -17.4%.", "next_check": "Check the operating costs behind the reported margin."}, "register": {"fact": "It was incorporated on 1995-04-01.", "next_check": "Verify the current register and signing authority."}, "trend": {"fact": "Revenue fell 6.8% from FY2023 to FY2024.", "next_check": "Check the sales breakdown behind the year-on-year movement."}}}
